_doc: Per-platform posting config for the local poster agent (see specs/specs.md: Local publish 1-3/3). Keys match config/ad-platforms.json. Only enabled platforms get Publish buttons; the rest stay manual. login_url is where the agent opens a headed browser on the operator's machine when a session is missing/stale; new_listing_url is where the posting script starts the listing form. login_success tells the agent's login detection (workers/posting/capture/detect.ts) when the operator has finished logging in: cookie = a cookie name that appears on success, redirect_off = a path the browser leaves on success. URLs for disabled platforms are best-effort placeholders — verify against the live site before enabling. Sessions live ONLY on the operator's machine at workers/posting/auth/<platform>.json (secrets — never expose via the files API or logs). land_com MUST gain a positive cookie signal: its redirect_off-only login_success false-positived on the Akamai Access Denied flow (see the Land.com access spike entry in specs/specs.md). The agent logs the session's cookie NAMES (never values) on every successful login capture — after the first real login on the operator's machine, take land_com's session-cookie name from that log line and add it here as login_success.cookie alongside redirect_off. When both cookie and redirect_off are set, detection requires BOTH (AND) — unit-tested in workers/posting/capture/detect.test.ts.

land_century._doc: Next.js SPA. There is no login page: logged-out visits to /admin bounce to the home page, where the account icon (top right) opens the Sign In modal. The session is the apiToken key in localStorage (plus the site's cookies); the create form (form.properties-admin-form) renders only when logged in. Mapped 2026-10-05 from the site's front-end source; see post-land_century.ts.

landflip._doc: Seller area is MY LANDFLIP at my.landflip.com (jQuery/Foundation, server-rendered; ajax actions on /json/listings). The public www.landflip.com sits behind Cloudflare and refuses headless browsers, so the poster never opens it (public URL is built as https://www.landflip.com/land/<id>). Sign-in lives under /sign-in; every logged-in page carries the sidebar Sign Out link. Title field is 35 chars (letters, digits, space - , . + / & $ ' only). Entry plan: 1 listing, 10 photos. Mapped 2026-10-12; see post-landflip.ts.

land_listings._doc: Laravel site. Plain POST login at /login (#email, #password); the account home is /dashboard and Sell Land goes to /add-a-listing (both bounce to /login when logged out; a logged-in visit to /login bounces away again). The dashboard sidebar (#dashboard-menu) and the POST logout form exist only when logged in. Publishing needs a paid membership (Premium Standard $49.95/mo or Deluxe $149.95/mo); a Free Account can only save Unlisted listings with one photo. Mapped 2026-10-05 from the public site and its API docs; the logged-in form is still to be confirmed, see post-land_listings.ts.
